text:
maria: Putting together the release notes + short changelog blurb for today's docs publish. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/PR-5342. Key items: policy-aware routing rollout, embedding dedup write optimization, Console per-route latency charts. Need quick editorial pass and any compliance note.

devin: quick read. Can you keep the opening line punchy? Something like: 'Improved routing and embed hygiene to lower costs and improve latencies.' then 3 bullets with one-line impact + who it affects.

maria: got it. I'll add the 3-line impact bullets and a one-sentence "who it affects" per bullet.

sam: heads up on SDK compatibility: Python/JS streaming flag renamed in v0.9. We should add a Known Issue and a short migration snippet for both languages. Also the embeddings client now has dedup hooks — mention possible duplicate prevention config.

sam: python snippet to include:
```python
# pre-0.9
client.generate("prompt", stream=True)
# 0.9+
client.generate("prompt", enable_stream=True)
```

sam: JS snippet: 
```js
// pre-0.9
client.generate('prompt', { stream: true })
// 0.9+
client.generate('prompt', { enableStream: true })
```

ellie: after yesterday's anchor rename there are several internal links that 404. I enumerated them in the PR comment and suggested redirects. We should add a short "link fixes" note in the changelog and recommend running `redwoodctl check-links` after publishing.

olivia: can docs maintainers add a redirect file for `/docs/api/console#model-routing` -> `/docs/api/console#routing-policy`? That was the most painful 404.

maria: ellie/olivia please add redirect PRs. i'll add a line in the release notes: "Fixed several anchors after docs refactor; redirects added for legacy links."

deploy-bot: docs-preview: build ok. preview URL: https://staging.docs.redwood/releases/5342-preview (expires in 48h).

devin: also add a short "Migration notes" box for Dedicated customers: when pinning model versions, recommend revalidating rollouts & fallback policies after upgrade to avoid routing surprises. Keep it 1-2 sentences.

sam: adding a note: embedding dedup defaults to `off` for older workspaces — call out how to enable it and a short caution about reindexing if you turn it on.

ellie: editorial nit: we should avoid product-jargon in the lead (e.g., "KL fallback"), use plain language and link to the detailed page. I'll push a tiny wording change.

maria: pushed edits: tightened lead, added who-it-affects lines, included Known Issues for streaming flag + anchors, and a short migration step for Dedicated customers about pinned models.

olivia: i've opened redirect PR: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/PR-5345. It redirects the 6 changed anchors.

sam: i'll open a small sync PR for the SDK snippets to ensure docs code blocks match released SDKs.

devin: timeline: send to product-marketing at 11:15 for punch-up and legal check; publish after 12:00 if no blockers. If you approve, reply with "LGTM".

maria: LGTM (thanks!).

ellie: LGTM from docs, will merge redirect PR after this lands.

sam: LGTM — tiny SDK sync PR coming.

olivia: LGTM and noted the redirect queue.

maria: merging in ~8 minutes unless anyone flags anything else. thanks! :shipit:
